title: Addition and Subtraction of 4-Digit Numbers
seo_title: Grade 4 Addition and Subtraction Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Add and subtract whole numbers of at least 4 digits; use techniques such as building up and breaking down numbers, rounding off and compensating, using a number line and using addition and subtraction as inverse operations.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 4 addition and subtraction worksheets: 4-digit column addition and subtraction with carrying and borrowing, checking and word problems. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Line up the columns and start with the units.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Write the numbers in columns: units under units, tens under tens, and so on.
  • Add or subtract from the units column to the left.
  • When a column adds up to 10 or more, carry 1 to the next column.
  • When the top digit is too small, borrow 1 from the next column (1 ten = 10 units).
  • Check: subtraction undoes addition. 6 352 − 2 817 = 3 535 because 3 535 + 2 817 = 6 352.

Examples

Example

4 768 + 2 385

8 + 5 = 13, carry 1

6 + 8 + 1 = 15, carry 1

7 + 3 + 1 = 11, carry 1

4 + 2 + 1 = 7

Answer: 7 153

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting to carryWrite the carried 1 above the next column.
Smaller from biggerIf the top digit is smaller, borrow.
Wrong columnsLine up the units.

faq.a: Add and subtract whole numbers of at least 4 digits, using techniques such as building up and breaking down numbers, rounding off and compensating, and using inverse operations.

faq.q: How do I check a subtraction?
faq.a: Add the answer to the number you subtracted.
Moving 10 units as 1 ten to the next column.
Yes. It shows if an answer is far off.

items.q: Musa worked out 8 140 − 3 965 = 4 175. Round each number to the nearest hundred to estimate. Is his answer sensible?
items.e: Estimate: 8 100 − 4 000 = 4 100. Musa's answer, 4 175, is close to the estimate, so it is sensible.
